
        <h2>
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/wqshare/p/19113653" title="发布于 2025-09-26 15:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Linux 系统升级 OpenSSL 3.1.3&amp; OpenSSH 10.0p2安装指南-踩坑日记</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Linux </strong><strong>系统升级</strong><strong> OpenSSL &amp; OpenSSH </strong><strong>安装指南</strong></p>
<p>适用场景：需要 OpenSSL ≥ 1.1.1，低版本系统需先升级 OpenSSL。<br>
注意：操作可能影响 SSH 登录，请严格按步骤操作。</p>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="2" width="100%">

</div>
<h1><strong>0. </strong><strong>应急措施</strong></h1>
<ol start="1">
<li><strong>保留应急登录方式</strong></li>
<ul>
<li><strong>不要关闭当前</strong><strong> SSH </strong><strong>会话</strong>，在新 SSH 未验证通过前，保持旧会话。</li>
<li>如果条件允许，建议开启 <strong>本地终端</strong><strong> / IPMI / </strong><strong>控制台</strong>，防止无法登录。</li>


 </ul>
<li><strong>备份旧版本</strong>（强烈建议）</li>


</ol>
<p># 备份 OpenSSH</p>
<p>sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/backup/openssh</p>
<p>sudo cp /usr/bin/ssh /usr/local/backup/openssh/</p>
<p>sudo cp /usr/sbin/sshd /usr/local/backup/openssh/</p>
<p>sudo cp -r /etc/ssh
/usr/local/backup/openssh/etc_ssh</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 备份 OpenSSL</p>
<p>sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/backup/openssl</p>
<p>sudo cp -r /usr/bin/openssl*
/usr/local/backup/openssl/ 2&gt;/dev/null || true</p>
<p>sudo cp -r /usr/lib64/libssl*
/usr/local/backup/openssl/ 2&gt;/dev/null || true</p>
<p>sudo cp -r /usr/lib64/libcrypto*
/usr/local/backup/openssl/ 2&gt;/dev/null || true</p>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="2" width="100%">

</div>
<h1><strong>1. </strong><strong>安装依赖环境</strong></h1>
<p><strong>CentOS / RHEL</strong></p>
<p>sudo yum groupinstall "Development Tools"
-y</p>
<p>sudo yum install wget curl zlib-devel -y</p>
<p><strong>Ubuntu / Debian</strong></p>
<p>sudo apt update</p>
<p>sudo apt install build-essential zlib1g-dev wget
curl -y</p>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="2" width="100%">

</div>
<h1><strong>2. </strong><strong>安装新版</strong><strong> OpenSSL</strong></h1>
<ol start="1">
<li><strong>检查版本</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>openssl version</p>
<ul>
<li>若 &lt; 1.1.1，需要升级 OpenSSL。</li>


</ul>
<ol start="2">
<li><strong>下载并解压源码</strong>（建议 3.x 版本）</li>


</ol>
<p>cd /usr/local/src</p>
<p>wget
https://www.openssl.org/source/openssl-3.1.3.tar.gz</p>
<p>tar -xzf openssl-3.1.3.tar.gz</p>
<p>cd openssl-3.1.3</p>
<ol start="3">
<li><strong>安装缺失的</strong><strong> Perl </strong><strong>模块（编译依赖</strong><strong>-</strong><strong>适用时）</strong></li>


</ol>
<p># RHEL / CentOS</p>
<p>sudo yum install perl-IPC-Cmd perl-core -y</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># Ubuntu / Debian</p>
<p>sudo apt install perl-modules build-essential -y</p>
<p>sudo cpan IPC::Cmd</p>
<ol start="4">
<li><strong>编译安装</strong><strong> OpenSSL</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>./config --prefix=/usr/local/openssl
--openssldir=/usr/local/openssl shared zlib</p>
<p>make -j$(nproc)</p>
<p>sudo make install</p>
<ol start="5">
<li><strong>配置环境变量</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>export PATH=/usr/local/openssl/bin:$PATH</p>
<p>export
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/openssl/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH</p>
<p>export
PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/openssl/lib64/pkgconfig:$PKG_CONFIG_PATH</p>
<ol start="6">
<li><strong>验证版本</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>openssl version</p>
<p># 应显示 OpenSSL 3.1.3 或更高</p>
<ol start="7">
<li><strong>系统全局库路径配置</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>sudo bash -c 'echo
"/usr/local/openssl/lib64" &gt; /etc/ld.so.conf.d/openssl-3.conf'</p>
<p>sudo ldconfig</p>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="2" width="100%">

</div>
<h1><strong>3. </strong><strong>安装</strong><strong> OpenSSH 10.0p2</strong></h1>
<ol start="1">
<li><strong>下载源码</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>cd /usr/local/src</p>
<p>wget
https://cdn.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/OpenSSH/portable/openssh-10.0p2.tar.gz</p>
<p>tar -xzf openssh-10.0p2.tar.gz</p>
<p>cd openssh-10.0p2</p>
<ol start="2">
<li><strong>配置编译，指定新</strong><strong> OpenSSL</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>./configure --with-ssl-dir=/usr/local/openssl
--sysconfdir=/etc/ssh</p>
<p>make -j$(nproc)</p>
<p>sudo make install</p>
<ol start="3">
<li><strong>验证安装</strong></li>


</ol>
<p>/usr/local/bin/ssh -V</p>
<p># 应显示 OpenSSH_10.0p2, OpenSSL 3.1.3 ...</p>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="2" width="100%">

</div>
<h1><strong>4. </strong><strong>常见问题与解决</strong></h1>
<p><strong>4.1 </strong><strong>编译</strong><strong> OpenSSL
</strong><strong>报</strong><strong> Perl </strong><strong>模块缺失</strong></p>
<p>Can't locate IPC/Cmd.pm in @INC ...</p>
<ul>
<li>解决：安装缺失 Perl 模块（见步骤 2.3）</li>


</ul>
<p><strong>4.2 </strong><strong>系统找不到</strong><strong>
libssl.so.3 / libcrypto.so.3</strong></p>
<p>openssl: error while loading shared libraries:
libssl.so.3: cannot open shared object file</p>
<ul>
<li>检查库文件</li>


</ul>
<p>ls -l /usr/local/openssl/lib64</p>
<ul>
<li>添加到系统动态库路径并刷新缓存</li>


</ul>
<p>sudo bash -c 'echo
"/usr/local/openssl/lib64" &gt; /etc/ld.so.conf.d/openssl-3.conf'</p>
<p>sudo ldconfig</p>
<p><strong>4.3 OpenSSH ./configure </strong><strong>仍检测到旧</strong><strong> OpenSSL</strong></p>
<p>checking OpenSSL library version... configure:
error: OpenSSL &gt;= 1.1.1 required (have "100020bf")</p>
<ul>
<li>原因：默认检测系统路径未找到新 OpenSSL</li>
<li>解决：<strong>编译时明确指定新</strong><strong> OpenSSL </strong><strong>路径</strong></li>


</ul>
<p>./configure --with-ssl-dir=/usr/local/openssl</p>
<ul>
<li>并确保：</li>


</ul>
<p>export
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/openssl/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH</p>
<p>export
PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/openssl/lib64/pkgconfig:$PKG_CONFIG_PATH</p>
<div align="center"><hr align="center" size="2" width="100%">

</div>
<h1><strong>⚠️</strong><strong>注意事项</strong></h1>
<ol start="1">
<li><strong>不要删除系统默认</strong><strong> OpenSSL</strong>，否则系统工具（curl、git 等）可能报错。</li>
<li><strong>保持旧</strong><strong> SSH </strong><strong>会话</strong>，避免新 OpenSSH 配置错误导致无法远程登录。</li>
<li><strong>路径中不要使用特殊字符</strong>（如 ! 或 |）。</li>
<li><strong>64 </strong><strong>位系统库路径</strong>：新库一般安装在
     lib64，不要写成 lib。</li>


</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
